meta.note: Cobalt colour scheme from app/assets/css/main.css (Nuxt UI variables set in CSS). Mock-derived values: dimmed text and the light accented border.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Text, text-muted and text-highlighted read on it at 4.5:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: bg-muted
tokens.usage: Subtle panels and table header ground.

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Cards, modals and menus: the solid surface that sits on bg.

tokens.name: bg-accented
tokens.usage: Selected or hovered fill with a cobalt tint; pressed states.

tokens.name: bg-inverted
tokens.usage: Inverted fill, e.g. a neutral solid button.

tokens.name: text-highlighted
tokens.usage: Headings, emphasized values and field labels on bg and bg-elevated.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy on bg, bg-muted and bg-elevated (16.7:1).

tokens.name: text-toned
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg and bg-elevated (7.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions, field labels, table headers, helper text on bg and bg-elevated (7.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-dimmed
tokens.usage: Placeholders and meta text on bg and bg-elevated: 4.6:1 light, 5.0:1 dark. Derived, not in the mocks.

tokens.name: text-inverted
tokens.usage: Text on primary and error-solid fills (6.8:1 on light primary, 5.4:1 on dark primary).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default hairline between rows and sections; decorative.

tokens.name: border-accented
tokens.usage: Field outlines. Light is 1.5:1 on bg, below the 3:1 control-border target (derived, flagged); dark is 3.6:1.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand and action fill: solid buttons, focus ring, selected radio and checkbox. As a mark on bg it is 6.3:1 light and 3.6:1 dark, so use it for fills and rings, not small text in dark.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for solid primary buttons.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Links, the active menu item and primary-colored text: 6.3:1 on bg light, 9.9:1 on bg-elevated dark. Use this, not primary, for text in dark.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: The business color: business badge and the business icon in the household and business rows (the ring segment itself uses the warning color). 5.4:1 light and 10.5:1 dark on bg-elevated; always paired with the word Business.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Destructive and failure color for icons and borders (6.6:1 light).

tokens.name: error-text
tokens.usage: Error text on bg-elevated: 6.6:1 light, 9.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: error-solid
tokens.usage: Fill of a solid delete button with text-inverted (6.6:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning state color; pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: chart-soft
tokens.usage: Bars of the months chart other than the current month (CSS --chart-soft). 1.70:1 light and 3.59:1 dark on bg-elevated; the light value misses 3:1 on purpose, every amount is also text and the current month is bold.

tokens.name: cobalt-50
tokens.usage: Cobalt scale step (--ui-color-primary-50); primary is 500 in light and 400 in dark.

tokens.name: cobalt-100
tokens.usage: Cobalt scale step (--ui-color-primary-100); primary is 500 in light and 400 in dark.

tokens.name: cobalt-200
tokens.usage: Cobalt scale step (--ui-color-primary-200); primary is 500 in light and 400 in dark.

tokens.name: cobalt-300
tokens.usage: Cobalt scale step (--ui-color-primary-300); primary is 500 in light and 400 in dark.

tokens.name: cobalt-400
tokens.usage: Cobalt scale step (--ui-color-primary-400); primary is 500 in light and 400 in dark.

tokens.name: cobalt-500
tokens.usage: Cobalt scale step (--ui-color-primary-500); primary is 500 in light and 400 in dark.

tokens.name: cobalt-600
tokens.usage: Cobalt scale step (--ui-color-primary-600); primary is 500 in light and 400 in dark.

tokens.name: cobalt-700
tokens.usage: Cobalt scale step (--ui-color-primary-700); primary is 500 in light and 400 in dark.

tokens.name: cobalt-800
tokens.usage: Cobalt scale step (--ui-color-primary-800); primary is 500 in light and 400 in dark.

tokens.name: cobalt-900
tokens.usage: Cobalt scale step (--ui-color-primary-900); primary is 500 in light and 400 in dark.

tokens.name: cobalt-950
tokens.usage: Cobalt scale step (--ui-color-primary-950); primary is 500 in light and 400 in dark.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Table cells, inputs, lists, descriptions (Nuxt UI text-sm).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Field errors, hints, month chart labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Form field gap, space under the h1.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections and dashboard cards.

tokens.name: card-padding
tokens.usage: Card padding from 640px width; 20px below it.

tokens.name: page-top
tokens.usage: Space above the page content in main.

tokens.name: page-bottom
tokens.usage: Space below the page content in main.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of pill buttons and width of icon buttons.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: UContainer max width (--ui-container 72.5rem).

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: UHeader height.

tokens.name: radius-base
tokens.usage: --ui-radius (0.75rem); Nuxt UI derives the others from it.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Fields, selects and non-pill buttons (1.5x base).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and menus (2x base).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards (.card).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill buttons (.pill) and icon buttons (.pill-icon).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards: soft shadow, no ring.
